title: The Quran: Surah 96, al-'Alaq (The Clot), verses 1 to 5
author: Tradução inglesa de Talal Itani (ClearQuran)
tradition: Texto sagrado do Islão, século VII
intro: Lição sobre a Surata 96 (versículos 1 a 5). O texto inglês é a tradução de Talal Itani, reproduzida sem alterações; as notas de língua, perguntas, discussão e escrita são material pedagógico separado, baseado apenas no que o próprio texto diz.

source.title: Quran English Translation: Clear, Pure, Easy to Read Modern English
source.edition: Edition A (uses the word 'Allah' to refer to the Creator)

questions.q: According to verse 4, how did He teach?
questions.why: O versículo 4 diz: 'He who taught by the pen.'

questions.q: The passage begins with 'Read'. What does this tell you about how the passage speaks?
options: It tells a story in the past
It asks a question about the weather
It gives an order directly to the reader
questions.why: 'Read:' no versículo 1 é uma ordem dirigida ao leitor.

questions.q: How many times does the word 'Read' appear in the passage?
questions.why: 'Read' aparece no versículo 1 e no versículo 3.

questions.q: Which sentence best sums up the passage?
options: A story about a long journey
A list of rules about trade
An order to read, with what the Lord created and taught: man, by the pen, what he never knew
questions.why: Os versículos 1 e 3 mandam ler, o 2 fala da criação do homem e os 4 e 5 falam de ensinar com a caneta.

B2.discussion: The passage speaks of teaching by the pen and of learning what we never knew. What is the last new thing you learned by reading or writing?
B2.writing: Write 80 to 100 words: Say what the verses tell the reader to do and what they say about the Lord.

questions.q: What did He teach man, according to verse 5?
questions.why: O versículo 5 diz: 'Taught man what he never knew.'
'Most Generous' é um superlativo: o grau mais alto de 'generous'.

questions.q: Verses 4 and 5 both use 'taught'. What link do they create?
options: A link between the pen, as the means, and what man never knew, as the result
A link between the clot and the pen
questions.why: O versículo 4 diz como (by the pen) e o versículo 5 diz o quê (what he never knew).

questions.q: Verses 1 and 3 both begin with 'Read:'. What does the repetition do?
options: It repeats the same command and adds a new description each time
It turns the passage into a question
questions.why: O versículo 1 junta 'who created' e o versículo 3 junta 'the Most Generous'.

options: The passage moves from teaching to a battle
The passage moves from creation (verses 1 and 2) to teaching (verses 3 to 5)
questions.why: Os versículos 1 e 2 falam de criar e os versículos 4 e 5 de ensinar, com o versículo 3 a ligar os dois.

C1.discussion: The command 'Read' opens the passage and returns in verse 3. How does the second 'Read' change what the reader expects?
C1.writing: Write 120 to 150 words: Explain how verses 4 and 5 develop the idea of verse 3.

glossary: In the Name of your Lord

questions.q: What does verse 2 say He created man from?
questions.why: O versículo 2 diz: 'Created man from a clot.'

questions.q: Verse 2 begins with 'Created' and has no subject of its own. How does it connect to verse 1?
options: It continues what verse 1 says about the Lord who created
questions.why: O versículo 1 acaba com 'who created' e o versículo 2 continua com 'Created man'.

questions.q: Verse 5 says 'what he never knew'. What does this phrase suggest about man before being taught?
options: That man did not have that knowledge by himself
questions.why: 'Never knew' indica um conhecimento que o homem não tinha.

questions.q: Which description of the passage's structure is best supported?
options: Command (1), creation (2), command again (3), teaching by the pen (4), what man never knew (5)
questions.why: Cada versículo tem uma função própria nesta sequência.

questions.q: What does the central position of verse 3, 'your Lord is the Most Generous', do?
options: It links creation (1 and 2) and teaching (4 and 5)
questions.why: O versículo 3 fica entre os que falam de criar e os que falam de ensinar.

C2.discussion: Creation comes first and teaching last, with generosity in the middle. What does this order suggest about the relation between being created and knowing?
C2.writing: Write 150 to 200 words: Analyse how the five verses are built around the two commands to read, referring to specific words.
